# SCI-FRUIT — required conditional predictions r0.3

Status: owner-directed Stage A prediction obligations. Authority: repair
direction SCI-FRUIT-OD-STAGE-A-TYPE-METHOD-REPAIR-2026-09-06, section 16.
These are statements to derive and make scientifically falsifiable in Stage B,
not numerical experiments authorized or performed in Stage A. A premise is
not a supplied numerical method. References to fixed joint linear conditions
mean the exact conditions in [the response table](RESPONSE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES.md).

| Prediction ID | Explicit premises | Required consequence or discriminating failure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-001 | Zero feedback contribution: m_k=0 and declared Pi_k(0)=B_k(0)=0 on otherwise identical compatible state/support | z_k=F_k(y_k^in), the declared residual-only route. Zero model values alone do not erase offsets in non-zero-preserving maps |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-002 | F_k is identity on compatible Y_k=Z_k, Pi_k and B_k are the identical removal/rejoin map, and support/arithmetic agree | z_k=y_k^in. A missing premise blocks this cancellation claim |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-003 | Fixed residual linear A_k and B_k=A_k Pi_k as exact maps on the declared model domain | D_k=0 and z_k=A_k y_k^in is model-independent under those fixed conditions |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-004 | Exact parent y_k^in=Pi_k(m_star), perfect accepted model m_star and zero-preserving residual processing | z_k=B_k(m_star); nonidentity rejoin does not imply true-sky identity or unit response, and differing domains cannot be equated |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-005 | Fixed joint linear relation, same y_k^in and operators, model m_star+delta_m | Model-induced output error relative to the same procedure with m_star is D_k delta_m; its conditional mean is the corresponding D_k-weighted bias component, not necessarily all bias relative to sky |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-006 | Inherited ordinary PTC fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient application versus separately named frozen-component subtraction | Their application and response rules are distinct; incidental equality for a special input does not make them interchangeable procedures |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-007 | Method explicitly permits a model-only output occurrence | It is model/prior-supported and adds no acquired exposure or independently measured sky value |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-008 | Unequal path support | Follow exactly one permitted information-origin class with its declared composition, or mark the affected output unavailable; no implicit filling or renormalization |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-009 | Model or consequential state depends on data | Full-procedure response includes that dependence and cannot be identified with fixed-state response without an exact equivalence argument; accidental equality is not general equivalence |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-010 | Query crosses a threshold, support, branch or terminal-selection boundary | Derivative may be unavailable; type the discontinuity/state transition rather than substituting a fixed-branch derivative |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-011 | Exact fixed joint linear relation with joint parent-model covariance | All four covariance terms are required; omitted cross terms require exact independence/conditioning authority |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-012 | Iterations reuse a parent or shared model/reference information | They do not become independent measurements and imply no 1/sqrt(iteration-count) uncertainty scaling |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-013 | Continuation-sufficient S_(N+1), exact same future controls and declared method/numerical profile | Continuation agrees with uninterrupted execution in the declared scientific states and results; an omitted consequential state defeats the premise |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-014 | Restart or relearning | Restart has a new lineage; relearning has an explicitly new state/method generation and dependence. Neither silently retains exact-continuation identity |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-015 | Iteration/resource maximum reached | This establishes its resource/stop state, not convergence or adequacy |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-016 | Terminal rule selects completed iteration N | Selection is a separate immutable record; the selected iteration and its state are not mutated or relabeled |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-017 | Observation-local versus coadd-level or jointly learned grouping | FRUIT(Coadd(y_o)) and Coadd(FRUIT(y_o)) are not equivalent by implication; any commutation requires exact compatible operators, learning and support premises |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-018 | Fixed-state NOI members versus per-realization relearned FRUIT/NOI members | Separate method/ensemble identities are required; they cannot share one ensemble under this core |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-019 | FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD is unavailable or lacks exact owner approval | No numerical FRUIT route or result is admitted, even if the conditional core is authored or frozen |
| SCI-FRUIT-PRED-020 | A FRUIT iteration/terminal bundle is complete under its own method | This does not establish Pointing, OOF, source/catalogue admission or production fitness; an absent downstream profile does not erase local completeness |

Stage B must preserve these IDs, state domains and assumptions, and distinguish
the exact algebraic conclusion from any measurement or performance assertion.
Predictions using zero or identity maps are conditional limiting cases, not
defaults, selected projectors, numerical populations or approved run plans.
